title: Mesh quality
summary: How clean your meshes are: face shapes (stretched, skewed or bent quads), triangles and n-gons, poles, non-manifold edges, and how crisp or soft your forms are.

request.brief: Submit a finished model whose topology you're happy with, as you'd hand it over.

questions.ask: Where do you accept triangles or n-gons (flat caps, hidden faces, never)?
